sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution is that, on 27.01.2023 father of victim lodged report alleging that four persons along with present applicant had committed forceful sexual intercourse with victim one by one due to which victim became pregnant and have also delivered a child on 26.01.2023.
Based upon which aforementioned crime was registered against four persons Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:33442 including present applicant and he was arrested on 28.01.2023.

3. Pursuant to notice issued, victim along with her father are present before this Court through through virtual mode from DLSA Korba, and they raises strong objection in grant of bail to applicant.
4.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated and there was no participation of present applicant in commission of the aforementioned offence.
Applicant is in jail since 28.01.2023 and therefore, he may be enlarged on regular bail.
5. Learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for applicant and submits that serious allegation of gang rape is alleged against applicant and three other co-accuse persons.

Age of victim is thirteen years and therefore, present applicant is not entitle for grant of bail.
6.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

7. Taking into considering the nature of allegation, age of victim and further submission of learned State counsel that present applicant is also engaged in commission of the offence, I do not find present to be a fit case to enlarge applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed.

Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
